do.label: Do
items: Write "Crustates" with a capital C, one word
Give the logo clear space at least the height of the crab's claw
Use the outlined mark on dark or busy backgrounds
Name areas as "Tide (compute)" the first time

dont.label: Don't
items: Recolour, stretch, rotate or add effects to the crab
Use the logo to suggest an official partnership or endorsement
Put the mark on rust or blue without its outline

words.heading: Names and boilerplate
words.name: Name
words.short: Crustates is an open source platform that turns your own hardware into a private cloud for VMs, apps and storage.
words.long: Crustates is an open source homelab platform built in Rust. It combines compute (full VMs and apps in microVMs), storage (ZFS and Btrfs pools, shares and backups) and networking (eBPF firewalling, automatic HTTPS and remote access) in one read-only, image-based OS with a single API. It runs on amd64 and arm64 and is licensed under the AGPLv3.
